<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

This PR enables Ulysses sp on CPU and adds a packed QKV kernel for the Ulysses all-to-all path.
After[ PR #35435](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35435) is merged, the Ulysses SP all_to_all_single path can use the group-aware CPU SHM implementation when the input meets the SHM eligibility requirements.

## Modifications

Add a CPU packed QKV kernel.
Integrate the packed QKV path into CPU Ulysses attention.
Enable Ulysses sequence parallelism on CPU.
Add unit test

- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+import os
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1800, suite="stage-a-tp-test-cpu-intel")
+
+DEFAULT_WAN_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST = "Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers"
+GENERATE_TIMEOUT = int(os.environ.get("WAN_GENERATE_TIMEOUT", "1800"))
+
+
+class TestDiffusionCPUParallel(CustomTestCase):
+    model = os.environ.get("WAN_MODEL_PATH", DEFAULT_WAN_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST)
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super().setUp()
+
+    def run_parallel_test(self, *, tp_size: int, sp_degree: int):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sglang_cpu_diffusion_") as tmp:
+            output_dir = Path(tmp) / "outputs"
+            output_dir.mkdir()
+            output_file = output_dir / "test.mp4"
+            log_path = Path(tmp) / "generate.log"
+            command = [
+                "sglang",
+                "generate",
+                "--model-path",
+                self.model,
+                "--tp-size",
+                str(tp_size),
+                "--sp-degree",
+                str(sp_degree),
+                "--ulysses-degree",
+                str(sp_degree),
+                "--ring-degree",
+                "1",
+                "--num-gpus",
+                str(tp_size * sp_degree),
+                "--prompt",
+                "A cat walking in a garden.",
+                "--width",
+                "256",
+                "--height",
+                "256",
+                "--num-frames",
+                "5",
+                "--num-inference-steps",
+                "2",
+                "--seed",
+                "42",
+                "--save-output",
+                "--output-path",
+                str(output_dir),
+                "--output-file-name",
+                output_file.name,
+            ]
+
+            env = os.environ.copy()
+            env.update(
+                SGLANG_DIFFUSION_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE="cpu",
+                SGLANG_DIFFUSION_TARGET_DEVICE="cpu",
+            )
+
+            with log_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log:
+                process = subprocess.Popen(
+                    command,
+                    stdout=log,
+                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+                    env=env,
+                    start_new_session=True,
+                )
+                timed_out = False
+                try:
+                    returncode = process.wait(timeout=GENERATE_TIMEOUT)
+                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                    timed_out = True
+                finally:
+                    kill_process_tree(process.pid)
+
+            log_text = log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+            log_tail = log_text[-16000:]
+
+            if timed_out:
+                self.fail(
+                    f"Diffusion generation timed out after {GENERATE_TIMEOUT}s.\n"
+                    f"Command: {' '.join(command)}\n"
+                    f"Generation log:\n{log_tail}"
+                )
+
+            self.assertEqual(
+                returncode,
+                0,
+                msg=(
+                    f"Diffusion generation failed with return code {returncode}.\n"
+                    f"Command: {' '.join(command)}\n"
+                    f"Generation log:\n{log_tail}"
+                ),
+            )
+
+            self.assertTrue(
+                output_file.is_file(),
+                msg=(
+                    f"Expected output video not found: {output_file}\n"
+                    f"Actual generated files: {[str(p) for p in output_dir.rglob('*')]}\n"
+                    f"Command: {' '.join(command)}\n"
+                    f"Generation log:\n{log_tail}"
+                ),
+            )
+
+            self.assertGreater(
+                output_file.stat().st_size,
+                0,
+                msg=(
+                    f"Generated video is empty: {output_file}\n"
+                    f"Command: {' '.join(command)}\n"
+                    f"Generation log:\n{log_tail}"
+                ),
+            )
+
+    def test_cpu_tp_only(self):
+        self.run_parallel_test(tp_size=2, sp_degree=1)
+
+    def test_cpu_sp_only(self):
+        self.run_parallel_test(tp_size=1, sp_degree=2)
+
+    def test_cpu_tp2_sp2(self):
+        self.run_parallel_test(tp_size=2, sp_degree=2)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+import sys
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import sgl_kernel  # noqa: F401
+import torch
+
+import sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.usp as usp
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="stage-a-test-cpu-intel")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16])
+def test_3d_cpu_packed_qkv_dispatch(dtype):
+    world_size = 2
+    s_local, h_global, d = 4, 8, 32
+    h_local = h_global // world_size
+
+    q = torch.randn(s_local, h_global, d, dtype=dtype)
+    k = torch.randn_like(q)
+    v = torch.randn_like(q)
+
+    def identity_a2a(x, role=None):
+        return x
+
+    def accelerator_kernel_must_not_run(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError("Accelerator QKV kernel called on CPU")
+
+    with (
+        torch.no_grad(),
+        patch.object(usp, "get_ulysses_parallel_world_size", return_value=world_size),
+        patch.object(usp, "_usp_all_to_all_single", side_effect=identity_a2a),
+        patch.object(
+            usp,
+            "pack_qkv_destination_major",
+            side_effect=accelerator_kernel_must_not_run,
+        ),
+    ):
+        q_out, k_out, v_out = usp._usp_input_all_to_all_packed_qkv(q, k, v)
+
+    expected = torch.stack(
+        [
+            torch.cat(
+                (
+                    q[:, r * h_local : (r + 1) * h_local],
+                    k[:, r * h_local : (r + 1) * h_local],
+                    v[:, r * h_local : (r + 1) * h_local],
+                ),
+                dim=-1,
+            )
+            for r in range(world_size)
+        ],
+        dim=0,
+    ).reshape(s_local * world_size, h_local, 3 * d)
+
+    eq, ek, ev = expected.split(d, dim=-1)
+    assert torch.equal(q_out, eq)
+    assert torch.equal(k_out, ek)
+    assert torch.equal(v_out, ev)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16])
+def test_pack_qkv_destination_major_cpu_is_bit_exact(dtype):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+
+    rows, world_size, global_heads, head_size = 17, 4, 12, 64
+
+    q, k, v = (
+        torch.randn(global_heads, rows, head_size, device="cpu", dtype=dtype).transpose(
+            0, 1
+        )
+        for _ in range(3)
+    )
+
+    local_heads = global_heads // world_size
+
+    expected = torch.empty(
+        world_size,
+        rows,
+        local_heads,
+        3 * head_size,
+        device="cpu",
+        dtype=dtype,
+    )
+
+    for index, tensor in enumerate((q, k, v)):
+        shards = tensor.view(rows, world_size, local_heads, head_size).permute(
+            1, 0, 2, 3
+        )
+
+        expected[..., index * head_size : (index + 1) * head_size].copy_(shards)
+
+    actual = torch.empty_like(expected)
+
+    result = torch.ops.sgl_kernel.pack_qkv_destination_major_cpu(
+        q, k, v, world_size, out=actual
+    )
+
+    assert torch.equal(result, expected)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__]))
